name: print-social-social-media-marketing-steps-infographic-mint-colour-blocks
title: 'Modern Social Media Marketing' six-step infographic in colour-block cards with a phone character megaphone
whatItIs: A mint-green infographic with 'MODERN SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING — Essential Steps' as the title, six colour-coded cards (pink, teal, yellow, purple, orange, magenta) each with a giant numeral (1-6), a bold label and short explanatory paragraph, connected in two branching columns, closing with a cartoon smartphone character shouting into a megaphone.
whatItMeans: Friendly and instructional; a cartoon character delivering the steps makes a marketing checklist feel approachable rather than dry.
techniques: Colour-code each step card differently for quick visual reference.
Branch steps into two parallel columns instead of one long list.
Close with a mascot character to add personality.

vocabulary.definition: A card presenting one stage in a numbered process.
An illustrated figure representing a brand or topic.
